title: os serve: a stack's plugin driver resolves its datasource's external.credentialsRef through the host's datasource secret binder (driver-odata on os serve) — epic #27261 P2
body:
epic:#27261#1 · marchtian · session_017ihL2c5z3q4h8inrn5kwqV
Filing gate: ① gap found by the #27747 guide carrier (PR #27871, os-dev-report 6513440511) and measured on `origin/main`.
Ruling-ref: 6486145005 (#27299, Tier B = declarative OData)
Dedupe (open AND closed): "os serve secret binder plugin driver credentialsRef sys_secret" → none this work.
Reader: the epic PM (#27261) dispatches it in the epic subtree.
type: Feature

## 维护者速读

- **做什么：** `os serve` 会创建数据源密钥解析器（`createDatasourceSecretBinder`，`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` 约 5310 行），但只交给 `DatasourceAdminServicePlugin`。栈里自己装的插件驱动（比如 `createODataDriverPlugin`）拿不到它，于是 `credentialsRef: 'sys_secret:…'` 在 `os serve` 上解析不了，作者只能自己传一个 `resolve`。
- **为什么：** 声明式 OData 的卖点是"只写元数据不写代码"。凭据这一步要写代码，卖点就破了。
- **需要您做的：** 无。

## Task

- [ ] The host publishes the read half of its datasource secret binder (`resolve(credentialsRef)`) as a kernel service. `driver-odata`'s plugin uses that service when `options.secrets` is absent; an explicit `options.secrets` still wins. Name the service and say whether other plugin drivers should read it the same way.
- [ ] Fail-closed stays: no service and no `options.secrets` ⇒ the request is refused, never sent unauthenticated.
- [ ] Tests: on a host that registers the service, a `sys_secret:` handle resolves; without it, the refusal is unchanged.
- [ ] Update `content/docs/data-modeling/odata-datasources.mdx` (#27871): drop the "pass your own resolve on os serve" caveat.

`Clause-②:` decided by the dev from the diff · `Metadata-protocol: none`.
